crossRefs.note: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”
Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

parallels.note: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall…
So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

translations.web: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
translations.bsb: and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
translations.kjv: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
translations.asv: and the two shall become one flesh: so that they are no more two, but one flesh.
